status: Local implementation ready for user review; no identity promotion or release
authorisation: User requested improvement of the gradient maker end to end and selected both editable palettes and image upload. No new canonical decision was created.

checks.foundationTokens: pass: maker CSS token references resolve against existing foundations
checks.verify_workbench: fail, existing baseline: verifier expects the original comparison workbench in brand-kit/index.html, which now redirects to the console. Its missing comparison core, labels and five-product checks are unrelated to the maker. Not repaired in this task.

browserChecks: Compose: preset, hex edits, spatial position, strength/flow controls and seed remix feed a generated source PNG and the existing extractor.
Upload: actual browser file selection produced a ready preview from a square PNG. Backend tests cover malformed, flat, non-square, transparent and oversized inputs.
Save, reload, edit and save produced two immutable candidate versions with lineage; saved versions survived page reload.

Two saved candidates compared in the dialog. Review form opened, accepted edits and dismissed without recording a human preference. Review persistence and append-only history are covered by backend tests.
Unreviewed filter returned two candidates; Shortlisted returned the expected empty state.
Sphere, disc, card, pill and Wings expressions were rendered and visually inspected. Source comparison preserves the full frame without cropping.
HTTP ZIP export succeeded. All eight immutable file hashes in the extracted package matched its manifest. The package renders using copied local dependencies.
Portable Wings preview was corrected to remove its source-image background when live; inspected after rebuilding both test candidates. Computed live background-image is none.
Main preview has one live core and one canvas. No unexpected browser console errors observed.
Full-page captures at 320, 375, 390, 768, 920, 1280 and 1440 were visually read, with no horizontal overflow. First-viewport captures at 375 and 1440 were also read.

designReview.T1: Pass. The light editing rail beside a contained charcoal material stage survives the 1280 and 375 stripped captures. The exact Wings geometry remains centred in the material aperture. The composition carries the source/proof relationship without relying on gradient decoration.
designReview.T2: Pass. Intro is editorial typography; editor is an authored control/proof split; collection is a compact comparison catalogue. No adjacent sections repeat a composition family. At 920px the editor columns measured 288px/529px; the collection has a separate layout. This is a functional editor rather than a marketing sequence.
designReview.T3: Pass in browser QA. Actual draw calls increased by 6859 between captures; 50.5 percent of core pixels changed at maximum-channel delta above 8. Exactly one live core. Simulated reduced-motion media query produced zero draws and the exact source pixels as static WebP; the visible layout remained stable. The operating system preference itself was not changed. WebGL-unavailable mode also used the static twin.
designReview.T4: Pass. The protagonist is the generated source and actual shared Living Core renderer, with real extracted anchors and real local versions. No invented product assignments or placeholder proof.
resolvedFindings: Source comparison initially cropped non-square expression captures; object-fit now contains the full frame.
Portable Wings initially retained a rectangular source background behind the mask; the template now clears the background in live mode.
designReview.rationale: The material is the strongest visual read, controls remain direct and source comparison sits beside the result. Foundation typography and a restrained control/proof split provide a coherent tool surface. This is an agent assessment, not the user's aesthetic approval.

evidence.captureMethod: Full-page browser captures were reliable. First-viewport and motion-core proofs were cropped from reliable captures using measured geometry, because viewport screenshots immediately after resizing and the screenshot clip option returned stale or incorrect frames on this machine.

limitations: Generation and saving require the local Python server; the static public host cannot run those operations.
Closing or reloading discards unsaved edits. Saved candidates are local gitignored files and must be exported to move between computers.
Candidate MZ-G IDs are provisional and must be reconciled at any later authorised import.
The animated core approximates the source; the PNG and decoded lossless WebP pixels remain exact colour authority.

The two agent-created test candidates were rebuilt after the portable-template fix. Their original immutable test folders were archived under the evidence directory; no user candidate was overwritten.
One shared repository verifier remains a documented pre-existing failure.

handoff.runtime: Updated server uses port 8915; parent preview on 8914 was not restarted.
handoff.authority: Research candidates only. Canonical masters, extractor, renderer, registries and releases were not modified.
handoff.nextAction: User can create and review local candidates. Import, product assignment and public release require their separate decisions.
